hypothesis: A source strategy's cost-stressed performance may persist for several independent markets, allowing a causal allocator to outperform an always-on fleet by following only a confirmed current champion.

frozen_mechanism.eligible_history: Current collection epoch and current experiment only; filled BUY takers with both data-quality and execution-fidelity grades A/B; one aggregate observation per resolved Polymarket market.
frozen_mechanism.performance_window: Latest 40 independent markets per source, with at least 20 total and 10 recent.
frozen_mechanism.activation: At least three consecutive profitable markets, positive recent mean, positive means in both rolling chronological halves and a positive one-sided 80% lower bound on doubled-cost return.
frozen_mechanism.confirmation: Two distinct scored outcomes from the same candidate after it first qualifies. Re-reading an unchanged leaderboard does not count.
frozen_mechanism.switching: Thirty-minute minimum dwell and a challenger lower-bound advantage of at least two return percentage points, confirmed on two distinct candidate outcomes.
frozen_mechanism.deactivation: A newly scored loss breaks the required streak and removes the incumbent immediately.
frozen_mechanism.copy_safety: Mirror only exactly one same-tick, same-market, ungrouped BUY taker intent. Reject makers, cancels, SELLs and every multi-leg bundle.
frozen_mechanism.execution: Independent 1.25-second quote-survival paper fill, no more than 20% of displayed touch, $1 minimum and $10 maximum notional, one meta order per market.
frozen_mechanism.state: Signal selection remains in memory; PostgreSQL is refreshed once per minute and is never queried on the order hot path. A stale performance snapshot disables orders.
frozen_mechanism.live_execution: None. The collector has no keys or order-posting path.

selection_disclosure: The source universe was chosen after extensive strategy research and therefore carries severe winner-selection risk. Source history is never counted as meta-strategy PnL. This new strategy begins at zero and is an explicit test of persistence, not evidence that streaks predict future profits.
decision_rule: After at least 300 fresh meta-strategy markets and 14 calendar days, require positive doubled-cost PnL in both chronological halves, market/day-clustered 95% lower confidence bounds above zero, multiple-testing correction including the full BORG fleet, no dominant source/asset/day, and positive 100/250/500ms counterfactuals. Otherwise reject strategy-level momentum.
zero_edge_disclosure: The likely null is winner's curse: the selected source stops working immediately after activation and the meta-strategy has zero or negative post-fee expectancy.
